_help: RFID Lab onboarding software list. This is the ONLY file to edit to add/remove tools.
sections[].rule: 'pick-one' (must select >=1), 'optional' (free multi-select), 'required' (locked in when missing).
software[].kind: 'gui' (desktop app: macOS cask / Windows winget / Linux desktop only — skipped on Linux servers)
or 'cli' (terminal tool: runs everywhere, and inside WSL when launched from a Windows host).
Per-OS command blocks: 'macos', 'linux', or 'any' (fallback used when the OS-specific block is absent).
Each block has an optional 'check' (defaults to the top-level 'check') and an 'install' list of {cmd, title?}.
A tool is only offered where an applicable block (or, for gui on Windows host, a winget_id) exists.
'check' must exit 0 (and ideally print a version) iff the tool is already installed.
'winget_id' installs gui apps on a Windows host; 'follow_up' lists commands the user runs afterwards.
Unknown keys (like this _help) are ignored, so leave notes freely.

sections.title: Code Editors — pick at least one

software.name: VS Code
software.description: Visual Studio Code — the most common choice, big extension ecosystem

macos.check: test -d '/Applications/Visual Studio Code.app' && echo installed || code --version | head -1

install.cmd: test -d '/Applications/Visual Studio Code.app' || brew install --cask visual-studio-code

command -v code >/dev/null 2>&1 || { curl -fsSL https://packages.microsoft.com/keys/microsoft.asc | sudo gpg --dearmor -o /usr/share/keyrings/ms-vscode-keyring.gpg && echo 'deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/ms-vscode-keyring.gpg] https://packages.microsoft.com/repos/code stable main' | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/vscode.list && sudo apt-get update -y && sudo apt-get install -y code; }

software.name: VSCodium
software.description: VS Code without Microsoft telemetry/branding

install.cmd: command -v codium >/dev/null 2>&1 || { curl -fsSL https://gitlab.com/paulcarroty/vscodium-deb-rpm-repo/raw/master/pub.gpg | sudo gpg --dearmor -o /usr/share/keyrings/vscodium-archive-keyring.gpg && echo 'deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/vscodium-archive-keyring.gpg] https://download.vscodium.com/debs vscodium main' | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/vscodium.list && sudo apt-get update -y && sudo apt-get install -y codium; }

software.description: hx — modern modal terminal editor, batteries included

install.cmd: command -v hx >/dev/null 2>&1 || { sudo apt-get install -y software-properties-common && sudo add-apt-repository -y ppa:maveonair/helix-editor && sudo apt-get update -y && sudo apt-get install -y helix; }

software.name: d4s
software.description: d4s — feature-rich terminal UI for Docker

install.cmd: export PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH; command -v d4s >/dev/null 2>&1 || { curl -fsSL https://d4scli.io/install.sh -o /tmp/d4s-install.sh && sh /tmp/d4s-install.sh $HOME/.local/bin; }

software.name: k9s
software.description: k9s — terminal UI for Kubernetes clusters

install.cmd: command -v k9s >/dev/null 2>&1 || { A=$(dpkg --print-architecture 2>/dev/null || echo amd64); curl -fsSL https://github.com/derailed/k9s/releases/latest/download/k9s_Linux_${A}.tar.gz -o /tmp/k9s.tgz && tar -xzf /tmp/k9s.tgz -C /tmp k9s && sudo install /tmp/k9s /usr/local/bin/k9s; }

install.cmd: command -v lazygit >/dev/null 2>&1 || { case $(uname -m) in aarch64) A=arm64;; *) A=x86_64;; esac; url=$(curl -fsSL https://api.github.com/repos/jesseduffield/lazygit/releases/latest | grep -o 'https://[^" ]*Linux_'$A'[^" ]*tar.gz' | head -1); curl -fsSL $url -o /tmp/lazygit.tgz && tar -xzf /tmp/lazygit.tgz -C /tmp lazygit && sudo install /tmp/lazygit /usr/local/bin/lazygit; }
